name: Ignite Master
author: team@ignite.network
description: Zentraler Rust-Master für das Ignite Minecraft-Netzwerk. Empfängt Backups von Servern, steuert Pterodactyl, managed nahtlose Server-Wechsel inkl. Proxy.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Ignite Master Installer
set -euo pipefail

ARCH=$(uname -m)

echo "[1/5] Target: ${GITHUB_REPO} / ${ARCH}"
mkdir -p /mnt/server && cd /mnt/server

if [ "${ARCH}" = "x86_64" ]; then
    echo "[2/5] Checking GitHub release..."
    RELEASE_JSON=$(curl -sfL "https://api.github.com/repos/${GITHUB_REPO}/releases/latest" || true)
    if [ -n "${RELEASE_JSON}" ]; then
        ASSET_URL=$(echo "${RELEASE_JSON}" | grep browser_download_url | grep -iF x86_64 | head -1 | cut -d'"' -f4 || true)
        if [ -n "${ASSET_URL}" ]; then
            echo "[3/5] Downloading: ${ASSET_URL}"
            curl -fL "${ASSET_URL}" -o release.tar.gz
            tar xzf release.tar.gz && rm release.tar.gz
            chmod +x ignite-master
            echo "[5/5] Installed from release."
            exit 0
        fi
    fi
    echo "[!] No x86_64 release, building from source..."
fi

echo "[2/5] Installing build dependencies..."
apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq build-essential curl pkg-config libssl-dev git 2>/dev/null

echo "[3/5] Installing Rust..."
curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -sSf https://sh.rustup.rs | sh -s -- -y 2>/dev/null
. "${HOME}/.cargo/env" || true

echo "[4/5] Cloning ${GITHUB_REPO}..."
rm -rf ignite-src
git clone --depth 1 "https://github.com/${GITHUB_REPO}.git" ignite-src
cd ignite-src/master

echo "[5/5] Building binary (this may take a while)..."
cargo build --release --quiet
cp target/release/ignite-master /mnt/server/
cp /mnt/server/ignite-src/ignite-config.example.toml /mnt/server/ 2>/dev/null || true
chmod +x /mnt/server/ignite-master
echo "[+] Build complete."

variables.name: Target A Address
variables.description: IP:Port von Server A (aus Master-Sicht, z.B. 172.18.0.2:25577)
